sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND ((COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid((p.traits ->> $2::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((p.traits ->> $2::text))::timestamptz END END > $3::timestamptz), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid((p.traits ->> $2::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((p.traits ->> $2::text))::timestamptz END END < $3::timestamptz), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid((p.traits ->> $2::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((p.traits ->> $2::text))::timestamptz END END <@ tstzrange($3::timestamptz, $4::timestamptz, '[)')), false) AND COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) <> 'null')), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid((p.traits ->> $2::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((p.traits ->> $2::text))::timestamptz END END <= $5::timestamptz), false) AND COALESCE((NOT (jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) <> 'null')), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid((p.traits ->> $2::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((p.traits ->> $2::text))::timestamptz END END <@ tstzrange($6::timestamptz, $7::timestamptz, '(]')), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid((p.traits ->> $2::text), 'timestamptz') THEN ((p.traits ->> $2::text))::timestamptz END END <@ tstzrange($7::timestamptz, $8::timestamptz, '[)')), false)))
